For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

{"command":"cd /testbed && python3 -c "
import yaml, json

manifest = yaml.safe_load(open('release-manifest.yaml'))

sbom_files = {
    'acme-auth-gateway': 'sbom/acme-auth-gateway.cdx.json',
    'acme-billing-api': 'sbom/acme-billing-api.cdx.json',
    'acme-notify-worker': 'sbom/acme-notify-worker.cdx.json',
}

for art in manifest['artifacts']:
    name = art['name']
    version = art['version']
    sbom = json.load(open(sbom_files[name]))
    meta = sbom['metadata']['component']
    assert meta['name'] == name, f'SBOM name mismatch for {name}'
    assert meta['version'] == version, f'SBOM version mismatch for {name}'
    assert sbom['bomFormat'] == 'CycloneDX', f'SBOM format mismatch for {name}'
    assert art['approved'] == True, f'{name} not approved'
    assert art['security_review'] == 'passed', f'{name} security review not passed'
    
    # Check for known-vulnerable deps (log4j < 2.17.0)
    for comp in sbom.get('components', []):
        if comp['name'] == 'log4j-core':
            v = comp['version']
            major, minor, patch = [int(x) for x in v.split('.')]
            assert (major, minor, patch) >= (2, 17, 0), f'{name} has vulnerable log4j-core {v}'
    
    print(f'  ✓ {name} {version} — identity verified, approved, deps clean')

print()
print('All 3 artifacts passed identity + SBOM + approval verification.')
"
"}
